text:
Safa (CS): Hi team — Acme reported their 50-credit promo landed in a newly provisioned org instead of their main workspace. They shared two IDs: expected org w_acme_42 and credited org w_acme_42-dup. promo txn promo_2025_FREE50. Can we triage?

James L. (Eng): ack. Can you paste the SSO provisioning event payload and the user email that completed onboarding? suspect an IdP change created a duplicate org.

Safa (CS): customer pasted this snippet from their SSO audit:
```
provision_event: {
  user_email: "bob@acme.com",
  saml_nameid: "urn:acme:users:1234-v2",
  timestamp: "2025-04-12T14:02:33Z",
  action: "create_org",
  created_org: "w_acme_42-dup"
}
```
They said the legacy org w_acme_42 was created pre-SSO and linked to SSO earlier. The IdP team rolled an update yesterday.

James L. (Eng): that NameID change would cause provisioning to treat as a new external_id. Looks like our SSO dedupe key is NameID only. If NameID changed we create a new org.

Priya R. (Billing): to move credits I need the promo txn id (we have it), current credited org ID (w_acme_42-dup) and target org ID (w_acme_42). I'll open a billing action and we can do a manual credit transfer. Confirming no invoices tied to the promo?

Safa (CS): customer says no invoices yet, trial-only.

Riley (Oncall): assigning to me to run the safety SQL and a dry-run first. Proposed query: 
```sql
SELECT id, org_id, promo_txn FROM credits WHERE promo_txn = 'promo_2025_FREE50';
-- then
UPDATE credits SET org_id = 'w_acme_42' WHERE promo_txn = 'promo_2025_FREE50' AND org_id = 'w_acme_42-dup';
```
I will do this in staging mirror then prod window.

James L. (Eng): also want a follow-up patch to onboarding: dedupe on (external_id OR primary_email) and detect NameID rotations. We should log a warning and not auto-create an org if there is a closely matching email owned by an existing org.

provision-bot: deploy status: provisioning-service v1.8.3 running. CI checks pass.

Riley (Oncall): ran the select in staging — found one credit row: (id=cc_9012, org_id=w_acme_42-dup, promo_txn=promo_2025_FREE50). Dry-run update succeeded. Scheduling prod change in 25m (will notify before running).

Priya R. (Billing): billing ticket BT-3284 opened. I'll tag finance approvers and include rollback plan.

Safa (CS): notified customer of planned manual fix and ETA ~30m. They appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:

Riley (Oncall): prod update complete. UPDATE affected 1 row (cc_9012). DB checksum matches staging.

Priya R. (Billing): confirmed promo moved, updated internal ledger, and attached BT-3284 notes. No downstream invoices impacted.

Safa (CS): customer confirmed credits are now visible in w_acme_42 and applied to their trial. They said they will ask IdP to preserve NameID or send an admin email to us next time.

James L. (Eng): root cause summary for the postmortem: IdP NameID rotation + onboarding dedupe keyed only on NameID -> new org created -> promo applied to the newly created org. Action items: (1) change dedupe to consider email fallback, (2) add a pre-create similarity check on email/domain, (3) add an alert when a provisioning event creates an org within 24h of an existing org with matching domain. I'll open ENG-SSO-55.

Priya R. (Billing): closing BT-3284 after we confirm ledger.

Safa (CS): thank you everyone. I'll follow up with the customer with the RCA and the timeline for the SSO onboarding fix. :white_check_mark:
